summary: The exact candidate bindings, two-SWU L1 topology, proof ceilings, execution route, closeout contract, JSON surfaces, and static byte checks pass. Acceptance is blocked because the 16-target package would leave two contradictory legacy planning surfaces canonical after apply. The separately missing design-validator-pass and selected Design binding remain an upstream normal-handoff gate, not a candidate-byte defect.

checks.evidence: PLAN.md, WORK-PACK.md, the context index, and the execution entry explicitly preserve the missing design-validator-pass and selected Design binding as blockers before normal Plan handoff or canonical activation. The execution entry has no selected unit, route, or next owner.

Exactly two proof SWUs are serialized: SWU-GCP-002-P4 then SWU-GCP-003-R4. Source/graph reconciliation, regeneration, freezing, and strict P4 effect proof are one non-separable P4 unit. R4 has 20 targets, zero source/generated-graph target, and replays the unchanged P4 handle. The composite verifier, test, and receipt are separate closure-verification targets, not R4 targets. The two unit target sets do not overlap.

P4 and R4 have distinct Rule, edge, obligation, binding, test, execution, mutation, and receipt identities. P4 proves only the selected one-way eligible-payout implication: exactly one PAYOUT write followed by exactly one matching event, with no converse. R4 proves only selected option A over otherwise-eligible inputs: zero same-date MAKEUP_APPLIED records is true and one or more is false, with other-date and other-type controls and no write/event claim. P4 requires 16 of 16 mutants; R4 requires 15 of 15.

Both SWUs declare dependencies, exact source and write surfaces, done criteria, validation commands, evidence paths, Task Session ownership, and explicit closeout targets. P4 closeout may expose only a fresh R4 selection; it may not execute the successor. R4 closeout routes to independent composite verification and cannot execute C0 or a provider.

All 62 currently planned absence-bound unit, governance, and closure targets were absent at review. Each unit terminal contract requires exact target equality, JSON/schema validation, exact-reference rehashing, and UTF-8/BOM/trailing-whitespace/terminal-newline checks over tracked and untracked/create outputs. Relationship and content regression run after P4 regeneration. The first-failure policy preserves the first nonzero acceptance-critical result, so a later diagnostic or cleanup cannot mask it.

The proposal remains blocked before Design validation/selection, independent review resolution, exact-byte owner acceptance, canonical apply, and readiness admission. C0, Datalog, Alloy, TLC, Cedar, provider installation/execution, authority, release, publication, deployment, Git mutation, implementation, and canonical apply are excluded. All reviewed authority_effect fields are none and release_admission is not-granted.

The target inventory neither updates nor retires work-pack/shared/GAPS.md, which still says missing L0 binding/evaluator/receipt and key-and-door material block L0 despite the bound SWU-GCP-001 PASS, nor work-pack/waves/W2-GRAPH-LAWS.md, which still presents a canonical Wave W2 blocked on W1 while the candidate installs the new W2 L1 repeatability wave. Applying only 16 targets would therefore leave contradictory current-looking canonical planning surfaces.

blocking_defects.affected_invariant: The exact postimage set must leave one coherent canonical planning frontier without contradictory current-state or wave surfaces.
blocking_defects.minimal_repair_proposal: Add exact postimages for both legacy surfaces that mark them superseded or redirect them to CROSS-TASK-GAPS.md and W2-L1-REPEATABILITY.md, or propose their explicit retirement as separately reviewable operations. Then regenerate the postimage inventory, all dependent digests, context/request bindings, and this independent review.

unresolved_gates.required_evidence: design-validator-pass plus selected exact Design binding; regenerate Plan package if Design bytes or meaning change
repaired exact package and fresh pass/flag/block independent review
fresh exact-byte acceptance followed by separate apply authorization and apply receipt
applied-byte Work Pack Readiness and Implementation Readiness admission

residue: The stale-survivor inspection was bounded to the canonical work-pack surfaces directly implicated by the old and proposed Work Pack links; no claim is made that every unrelated repository file was exhaustively classified.
maximum_honest_claim: The frozen proposal has a mechanically consistent exact-byte package and a bounded, well-separated P4-then-R4 L1 proof design, but it is not acceptance-ready because its target set leaves contradictory legacy planning surfaces canonical. This receipt does not validate or select Design, authorize canonical apply, admit execution, implement either SWU, execute a provider, prove L1 behavior, or establish authority, release, publication, deployment, or production readiness.
